content:
We’re looking for an AI Engineer to help us design, evaluate, and scale our next generation of LLM-powered agents. This role is deeply technical, but also product and customer-oriented: you’ll build datasets, run evaluations, improve model performance, and ensure our agents deliver real value in real workflows.

content:

100ms is building AI agents that automate complex patient access workflows in U.S. healthcare — starting with benefits verification, prior authorization, and referral intake in specialty pharmacy.

content:
Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!

Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Our platform empowers data teams to manage products effectively by ensuring data quality, preventing failures, and controlling costs.

title: Principal Engineer - Open Source Data Platform (ODP)
content:
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking a Principal Engineer with at least 14 years of experience to serve as a technical visionary and thought leader for Acceldata's Open Data Platform (ODP). In this role, you will define the long-term technical strategy, lead the most complex architectural initiatives, and represent Acceldata in the global open-source and distributed systems community. You will work directly with engineering leadership and executives to shape product direction while driving innovation across the organization.
WHY JOIN US?
As a Principal Engineer at Acceldata, you will be at the forefront of shaping the future of enterprise data platforms, defining the technical vision for systems that power mission-critical workloads across the world's largest organizations. Your decisions will directly influence not only our platform but also the broader data ecosystem through open-source contributions and industry leadership.
You'll work alongside Apache members, committers, and industry veterans who are passionate about solving the hardest problems in distributed computing. This is a rare opportunity to combine deep technical impact with strategic influence, building technology that matters while shaping the direction of a growing data observability company.

title: Sales Development Representative | Enterprise (US Time Zone)
content:
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Sales Development Representative at Acceldata, you will drive the company's growth by identifying and qualifying potential enterprise business opportunities. Your primary responsibility will be to generate enterprise leads and establish connections with prospective clients, showcasing Acceldata's value proposition.
Collaborating closely with our field AEs and marketing teams, you will help build a robust pipeline of opportunities and convert prospects into satisfied customers.

content:
Acceldata is reimagining the way companies observe their Data!

Acceldata is the pioneer and leader in data observability, revolutionizing how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive insights into various key aspects of data, data pipelines and data infrastructure across various environments. Senior AI Engineer – Backend Engineering (Agentic AI)
About the Role
We are looking for an AI Engineer with strong backend engineering experience and hands-on experience building Agentic AI systems. The ideal candidate should have built and deployed AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, using tools, interacting with multiple systems, and executing multi-step workflows in real-world applications.
What You’ll Do
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs.
Build and deploy Agentic AI systems that can reason, plan, use tools, and execute complex workflows.
Develop multi-agent systems and orchestrate interactions between multiple AI agents.
Build LLM-powered applications using RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search.
Integrate LLMs and AI models into production-grade backend applications.
Develop reliable agent workflows with appropriate memory, context management, and guardrails.
Optimize AI application performance, scalability, reliability, and response times.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to take AI capabilities from concept to production.
What We’re Looking For
Strong programming experience in Python, Java, or Go.

title: Associate SDE
content:
About Hevo:
Hevo is a Series B data infrastructure company with $42M raised.
More than 2,000 companies across 40 plus countries use Hevo to move data from more than 150 sources into platforms such as Snowflake and BigQuery.
Our customers include DoorDash, Shopify, Pinterest, Postman and Icelandair.
Our engineering team is built in India, and so are the decisions.
We are not the remote engineering office of a US company.
The people building the product are the people deciding what to build.
 
What we are building:
We are building an AI system that creates data connectors by itself and keeps them working by itself.
No engineer should need to manually build every connector. No engineer should need to come back six months later because the source API changed.
Work that traditionally takes weeks or months should take hours. But building a connector is not the hardest part.
The real question is: Would you trust this system to run by itself, with nobody watching, for months?
That is the job.
What you’ll own as Associate SDE at Hevo:
Implement SaaS connectors for assigned applications, learning application specific nuances like basic auth and data extraction.
Assist in building simple REST API components, focusing on clean implementation and testing.
Debug and optimize code for data pipeline efficiency under mentorship.
Contribute to feature breakdown, coding, and documentation for smaller tasks.
Apply logical thinking to solve integration issues and improve component quality.
Build internal tools with AI for business teams to run their functions
 
What you’ll bring to the table:
Basic object-oriented programming skills and familiarity with design principles.
Exposure to data pipelines or APIs; eagerness to learn concurrency and performance basics.
Foundational knowledge of REST APIs (e.g., making calls, handling JSON) – no deep expertise needed.
Proficiency in Java/TypeScript/Python, good problem-solving with data structures and algorithms.
Strong analytical and logical thinking for real-world challenges.
 
Candidate Persona:
Freshers with experience in software development, ideally with internships in integrations or data tools.
B Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college.
 
Why this role:
Very few teams are building autonomous AI systems that operate production infrastructure where being wrong has real consequences.
This is not a chatbot. It is infrastructure that has to remain correct, quietly, for months.
If that kind of problem excites you, there are not many places working on it this early.
You can talk to anyone in the company, including the CEO.
What you are trusted with depends on what you can do, not your title.

Role Summary
An Associate Customer Experience Engineer owns customer issues end-to-end, keeps unnecessary escalations to a minimum, and ensures every interaction reflects a high standard of customer experience.
This role centers on troubleshooting JDBC-based sources and integrations, partnering closely with Product and Engineering whenever an issue calls for deeper investigation. The role calls for building solid technical depth over time, following and refining support workflows, putting AI and automation to good use, and adding to the team's shared knowledge so issues get resolved faster and more consistently across the board.
Key Responsibilities
Own customer issues and drive them to resolution within SLA timelines, combining structured investigation with clear, timely updates to the customer.
Investigate issues by digging into SQL, logs, API responses, database behavior, product documentation, and other diagnostic tools available.
Loop in Product and Engineering as needed, sharing the relevant technical context, investigation findings, and steps to reproduce the issue.
Keep unnecessary escalations to a minimum by building strong product and technical knowledge and resolving issues independently wherever possible.
Follow established support processes and flag improvements that cut down on rework, manual effort, and resolution time.
Use AI-assisted tools, automation, and diagnostic capabilities to make troubleshooting faster and more consistent.
Build deeper technical expertise in JDBC-based sources and integrations, along with databases, APIs, ETL, and related technologies.
Add to SOPs, KB articles, onboarding material, and other knowledge assets the wider team relies on.
Support teammates when needed and take an active part in team training, enablement, and knowledge-sharing activities.
What Success Looks Like
Steady SLA adherence combined with consistently high-quality resolutions on owned tickets.
A growing ability to resolve technically complex issues without outside help.
An avoidable escalation rate that stays low and keeps trending downward.
Customer communication that is clear, accurate, and easy to act on.
Meaningful, ongoing contributions to SOPs, KBs, and broader team enablement.
Real, measurable use of AI and automation to cut down on manual effort and resolution time.
Visible growth in technical depth and troubleshooting capability over time.
Required Skills & Experience
Solid grasp of cloud technologies and core database concepts, including the basics of database administration.
Hands-on experience troubleshooting databases, applications, or integrations.
Strong command of SQL.
Familiarity with data warehousing, ETL, REST APIs, and webhooks.
Working knowledge of Java or another object-oriented programming language.
Sharp troubleshooting, debugging, research, and problem-solving abilities.
Background in technical product support, including email-based support.
Able to write and maintain clear technical documentation such as KBs and SOPs.
Strong written and verbal communication with a sharp eye for detail.
Genuinely curious and customer-first, with the ability to break down and synthesize technical information effectively.
Preferred Qualifications
2–5 years in technical product support, application support, database support, or a similar technical role.
Hands-on experience troubleshooting JDBC-based sources or integrations.
DBA experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or a similar database platform.
Background supporting B2B SaaS products or integration platforms.
Exposure to ETL/data integration platforms.

title: Growth Specialist
content:
About Hevo
Hevo is a simple, no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies unify and prepare their data for analytics and AI. Hevo enables 2,500+ data-driven companies, including DoorDash, Shopify, and Postman, to get their data AI-ready by automating complex integration and transformation tasks across hundreds of sources.
 

 
About the Role
Pipeline doesn't appear out of thin air. Somewhere before every closed deal, there's an email that got opened at exactly the right time, a LinkedIn campaign that made someone stop scrolling, a nurture sequence that quietly did its job, or a conversation at a US trade show that started with "so what does Hevo actually do?"
You'll be the person behind those moments. As our Demand Generation Executive, you'll run the multi-channel campaigns, nurture programs, and account-based plays that keep Hevo's US pipeline healthy, and you'll execute field events and webinars end-to-end as part of that mix. The playbooks exist. The channels work. What we need is someone who ships consistently, follows up relentlessly, and gets a little competitive about the pipeline number.

What You'll Do
Field Events (end-to-end execution): Run trade shows, roundtables, meetups, and partner events in the US, from pre-event outreach and logistics through on-site operations and post-event follow-up, so attendees turn into pipeline and not just a nice photo for LinkedIn.
Webinars: Own monthly webinar promo cycles across email, LinkedIn, partner, and BDR outreach, with accurate registration tracking, CRM campaign association, and attendee follow-up.
Lead Nurturing: Build and maintain email nurture workflows that move leads from "just browsing" to sales-ready, and keep improving conversion at every stage.
ABM Support: Support account-based plays for priority accounts by coordinating targeted outreach and personalized follow-up with BDRs and AEs.
Sales Alignment: Work with BDRs on lead handoff and timely follow-up, and keep the CRM clean enough that nobody has to ask "wait, where did this lead come from?"
Reporting: Track and report on registrations, MQLs, meetings booked, and pipeline sourced and influence. 
Content Support: Help turn customer stories, webinar recordings, and exec thought leadership into campaign assets and LinkedIn content, coordinating with AMs/TAMs, Design, and execs all the way to approval and publishing.
 

 
What You Bring
Experience: 2–5 years in demand generation, field marketing, or event marketing, preferably at a B2B SaaS or technology company.
Events Execution: Hands-on experience running field events and webinars end-to-end, from promotion and logistics through on-site operations and post-event follow-up. This one's non-negotiable.
Campaign Skills: Experience running multi-channel promotion (email, LinkedIn, partner, BDR outreach). US audience experience is a strong plus.
Tools: Working knowledge of HubSpot; exposure to LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Google Analytics is a bonus.
Analytical Mindset: Comfortable living in spreadsheets and dashboards, and curious about why a campaign worked (or didn't).
Writing: Strong copywriting across emails, and event invites, the kind people actually read.
Execution: You hit deadlines without being chased, and you're comfortably persistent when it comes to chasing approvals and stakeholders to closure.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication, and at ease working with BDRs, AEs, AMs/TAMs, Design, partners, and execs.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
Why This Role?
You won't be a small cog in a giant marketing machine. You'll own execution on the programs that feed a big share of Hevo's US pipeline, and you'll see exactly which campaigns, events, and emails turned into revenue. No guessing, no vanity metrics, just a clear line from your work to the deals that close.
And it's built to grow. Start by owning execution across campaigns, events, and webinars. Build a track record, and there's room to take on campaign strategy and pipeline targets directly, and grow into a Demand Generation Manager role.

title: Head of Premier Technical Support
content:
About Hevo
Hevo Data is a no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.
Over 2,000 data teams in 45+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Arhaus, and Santander. We're top-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.
Why This Role Matters
Hevo's customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who run critical data infrastructure on us. When a pipeline breaks, their dashboards, reports, and downstream systems break with it. For our top accounts, every interaction with Hevo should feel white-glove: proactive, personal, and technically credible.
Premier Support at Hevo is not a ticket queue. It is a named, technical account management function that partners closely with our Account Management team to drive adoption, deepen usage, and protect renewals across our most valuable customers. Account Managers own the commercial relationship; you and your team own the technical relationship and the day-to-day customer experience that keeps these accounts healthy and growing.
We're looking for a hands-on leader who is equally at home in a customer business review, a Sev-1 war room, a weekly team operating review, and an API error log. We're a startup: you'll inherit a strong team and a solid foundation, not a finished playbook, and you'll be expected to build what's missing.
The Setup
A growing team of Technical Account Managers/Premier Support Engineers, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
1,000+ customers, with a dedicated premier engagement model for our top 250–300 accounts that you will shape
A close partnership with Account Management: they own the commercial relationship, your team owns technical success, adoption, and the customer experience
A customer base spanning SMB to Enterprise across e-commerce, Fintech, Medtech, and B2B Software
Strong executive support and investment in white-glove, proactive customer engagement
A chance to define what premier support means at a company leading the data pipeline category

What This Role Is Built On
Four things matter most for success in this role, and we hire and evaluate against all four: customer management and communication, team management and operational diligence, technical strength in B2B cloud technologies, and high agency. The responsibilities below are organized around them.
Responsibilities
1. Customer Management and Communication
Own the technical relationship with premier accounts end to end: onboarding, adoption, stability, escalations, and renewal readiness
Deliver a white-glove experience for top customers: named coverage, proactive check-ins, regular business reviews, and a single accountable point of contact when things go wrong
Partner with Account Managers on joint account plans, QBRs, renewal risk reviews, and expansion opportunities, always leading with adoption and retention
Drive adoption: make sure customers are getting value from the pipelines, sources, and features they bought, and catch usage drops before they become churn risks
Personally lead high-severity and executive-level escalations, and run clear, timely incident communication and customer-facing RCAs
Build customer advocacy through NPS/CSAT programs, references, and case studies
2. Team Management and Operational Diligence
Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of TAMs and Premier Support Engineers, including future team leads
Design and run the operating model: account segmentation (Enterprise, Mid-market, Growth), coverage ratios, SLAs, severity levels, and escalation framework
Build playbooks for onboarding, proactive health monitoring, health scoring, escalation management, renewal readiness, and expansion
Define and track input and output metrics, and use them to run the team week to week:
Input: First Response Time, Time-to-Resolution, backlog and ticket aging, escalation rate, proactive touchpoints, business review coverage, pipeline health coverage
Output: CSAT, NPS, Time-to-Value, Adoption, Health Scores, NRR, GRR
Run a disciplined weekly cadence on at-risk accounts, open escalations, and team capacity, with clear owners and follow-through
Report key metrics and insights to the executive team
3. Technical Leadership
Be the most credible technical voice for premier customers: get hands-on with pipeline failures, API and integration issues, data latency, schema changes, and source/destination problems alongside your engineers
Diagnose issues across the B2B cloud stack: REST APIs, authentication (OAuth, API keys), rate limits, webhooks, networking, and cloud data warehouse
Be the voice of the premier customer to Product and Engineering, turning support and adoption trends into roadmap and reliability priorities
Raise the team's technical bar through enablement, runbooks, and knowledge sharing, so new hires become productive fast
Use AI, automation, and self-serve tooling to improve resolution speed and scale the team's impact without growing headcount at the same rate
4. High Agency and Building
Build the premier support function from where it is today: spot gaps, make decisions, and ship improvements without waiting for a finished blueprint
Roll up your sleeves when needed, whether that means taking a key account, jumping on a ticket, or building the first version of a dashboard yourself
Make calls with incomplete information, own the outcome, and adjust quickly
Drive change across Account Management, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance through data and influence rather than authority
Own the outcome metrics for the premier base: Gross Retention, Net Revenue Retention, and Adoption

Who We're Looking For
Must-Have
Experience: 12–18 years overall, with 5+ years leading Technical Account Management, Premier / Enterprise Support, Customer Success Engineering, or Support Engineering teams in B2B SaaS
Customer management and communication: a track record of owning relationships with enterprise customers, personally handling critical escalations, and turning at-risk accounts into advocates. Clear and crisp in writing and in the room, with both a customer's engineers and their C-level executives
Team management and operational diligence: has built and run a team on a clear operating rhythm of KPIs, SLAs, and reviews; understands how input metrics drive outcomes; has hired well and made hard people calls
Technical strength: hands-on depth in B2B cloud technologies: SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), ideally with exposure to data systems (databases, warehouses, ETL/ELT). You can read logs, debug a failing API call or pipeline, and hold your own with a customer's engineers
High agency: clear evidence of building or rebuilding a function rather than just running an existing one, ideally in a startup or high-growth environment. You act without waiting for permission and own results end to end
Commercial awareness: understands how adoption and customer experience drive renewal and expansion, and has partnered with Account Management or Sales on retention outcomes

Nice-to-Have
Time spent at a modern data stack, integration, or cloud infrastructure company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, Confluent, or similar)
Direct ownership of retention and expansion metrics (NRR, GRR) in a subscription or recurring-revenue business
Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing, and using usage data to drive adoption
Mix of technical (engineering, SRE, solutions) and business (support, CS, account management) experience
Experience managing teams across multiple geographies or time zones, especially supporting US customers from India
Experience introducing AI or automation into support or customer success operations

Why Hevo
We're in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B+) and we're one of the leaders
Our customers actually like the product: top-rated on G2, with strong word-of-mouth growth
Sequoia Capital-backed with strong investor support
Premier support is treated as a growth and retention function here, not a cost center. You'll have real ownership and a seat at the table
Startup pace and scope: your decisions show up in customer outcomes within weeks, not quarters
Low-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

When a pipeline breaks, their dashboards, reports, and downstream systems break with it. For our top accounts, every interaction with Hevo should feel white-glove: proactive, personal, and technically credible.
Premier Support at Hevo is not a ticket queue. It is a named, technical account management function that partners closely with our Account Management team to drive adoption, deepen usage, and protect renewals across our most valuable customers. Account Managers own the commercial relationship; you and your team own the technical relationship and the day-to-day customer experience that keeps these accounts healthy and growing.
We're looking for a hands-on leader who is equally at home in a customer business review, a Sev-1 war room, a weekly team operating review, and an API error log. We're a startup: you'll inherit a strong team and a solid foundation, not a finished playbook, and you'll be expected to build what's missing.
The Setup
A growing team of Technical Account Managers/Premier Support Engineers, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
1,000+ customers, with a dedicated premier engagement model for our top 250–300 accounts that you will shape
A close partnership with Account Management: they own the commercial relationship, your team owns technical success, adoption, and the customer experience
A customer base spanning SMB to Enterprise across e-commerce, Fintech, Medtech, and B2B Software
Strong executive support and investment in white-glove, proactive customer engagement
A chance to define what premier support means at a company leading the data pipeline category

What This Role Is Built On
Four things matter most for success in this role, and we hire and evaluate against all four: customer management and communication, team management and operational diligence, technical strength in B2B cloud technologies, and high agency. The responsibilities below are organized around them.
Responsibilities
1. Customer Management and Communication
Own the technical relationship with premier accounts end to end: onboarding, adoption, stability, escalations, and renewal readiness
Deliver a white-glove experience for top customers: named coverage, proactive check-ins, regular business reviews, and a single accountable point of contact when things go wrong
Partner with Account Managers on joint account plans, QBRs, renewal risk reviews, and expansion opportunities, always leading with adoption and retention
Drive adoption: make sure customers are getting value from the pipelines, sources, and features they bought, and catch usage drops before they become churn risks
Personally lead high-severity and executive-level escalations, and run clear, timely incident communication and customer-facing RCAs
Build customer advocacy through NPS/CSAT programs, references, and case studies
2. Team Management and Operational Diligence
Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of TAMs and Premier Support Engineers, including future team leads
Design and run the operating model: account segmentation (Enterprise, Mid-market, Growth), coverage ratios, SLAs, severity levels, and escalation framework
Build playbooks for onboarding, proactive health monitoring, health scoring, escalation management, renewal readiness, and expansion
Define and track input and output metrics, and use them to run the team week to week:
Input: First Response Time, Time-to-Resolution, backlog and ticket aging, escalation rate, proactive touchpoints, business review coverage, pipeline health coverage
Output: CSAT, NPS, Time-to-Value, Adoption, Health Scores, NRR, GRR
Run a disciplined weekly cadence on at-risk accounts, open escalations, and team capacity, with clear owners and follow-through
Report key metrics and insights to the executive team
3. Technical Leadership
Be the most credible technical voice for premier customers: get hands-on with pipeline failures, API and integration issues, data latency, schema changes, and source/destination problems alongside your engineers
Diagnose issues across the B2B cloud stack: REST APIs, authentication (OAuth, API keys), rate limits, webhooks, networking, and cloud data warehouse
Be the voice of the premier customer to Product and Engineering, turning support and adoption trends into roadmap and reliability priorities
Raise the team's technical bar through enablement, runbooks, and knowledge sharing, so new hires become productive fast
Use AI, automation, and self-serve tooling to improve resolution speed and scale the team's impact without growing headcount at the same rate
4. High Agency and Building
Build the premier support function from where it is today: spot gaps, make decisions, and ship improvements without waiting for a finished blueprint
Roll up your sleeves when needed, whether that means taking a key account, jumping on a ticket, or building the first version of a dashboard yourself
Make calls with incomplete information, own the outcome, and adjust quickly
Drive change across Account Management, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance through data and influence rather than authority
Own the outcome metrics for the premier base: Gross Retention, Net Revenue Retention, and Adoption

Who We're Looking For
Must-Have
Experience: 12–18 years overall, with 5+ years leading Technical Account Management, Premier / Enterprise Support, Customer Success Engineering, or Support Engineering teams in B2B SaaS
Customer management and communication: a track record of owning relationships with enterprise customers, personally handling critical escalations, and turning at-risk accounts into advocates. Clear and crisp in writing and in the room, with both a customer's engineers and their C-level executives
Team management and operational diligence: has built and run a team on a clear operating rhythm of KPIs, SLAs, and reviews; understands how input metrics drive outcomes; has hired well and made hard people calls
Technical strength: hands-on depth in B2B cloud technologies: SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), ideally with exposure to data systems (databases, warehouses, ETL/ELT). You can read logs, debug a failing API call or pipeline, and hold your own with a customer's engineers
High agency: clear evidence of building or rebuilding a function rather than just running an existing one, ideally in a startup or high-growth environment. You act without waiting for permission and own results end to end
Commercial awareness: understands how adoption and customer experience drive renewal and expansion, and has partnered with Account Management or Sales on retention outcomes

Nice-to-Have
Time spent at a modern data stack, integration, or cloud infrastructure company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, Confluent, or similar)
Direct ownership of retention and expansion metrics (NRR, GRR) in a subscription or recurring-revenue business
Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing, and using usage data to drive adoption
Mix of technical (engineering, SRE, solutions) and business (support, CS, account management) experience
Experience managing teams across multiple geographies or time zones, especially supporting US customers from India
Experience introducing AI or automation into support or customer success operations

Why Hevo
We're in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B+) and we're one of the leaders
Our customers actually like the product: top-rated on G2, with strong word-of-mouth growth
Sequoia Capital-backed with strong investor support
Premier support is treated as a growth and retention function here, not a cost center. You'll have real ownership and a seat at the table
Startup pace and scope: your decisions show up in customer outcomes within weeks, not quarters
Low-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

title: PLG Growth Manager
content:
About Hevo
Hevo is a simple, no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies unify and prepare their data for analytics and AI. Hevo enables 2,500+ data-driven companies, including DoorDash, Shopify, Postman, and Groww, to get their data AI-ready by automating complex integration and transformation tasks across hundreds of sources.
By removing engineering bottlenecks, Hevo allows teams to focus on what actually matters: generating insights, building intelligent products, and making faster decisions.
 
What You Will Own
You own how prospects find Hevo and what happens once they arrive. That spans the organic growth engine, the editorial voice, and AEO strategy that brings technical buyers to the site, plus the trial experience that turns a signup into a paying customer. The two halves are connected: the content you publish sets the intent of the person who signs up, and the trial experience decides whether that intent converts.
This role sits roughly 60% on inbound and organic growth, 40% on trial lifecycle and PLG conversion. You are not a reporter of traffic or a reporter of conversion rate. You are the person who defines what good looks like on both sides of the funnel, instruments it, and ships the work that moves it.
 
Core Responsibilities
1. Inbound, Editorial, and AEO (Primary)
Own Hevo's organic growth strategy and editorial voice across inbound, AEO, and content: find opportunities, plan, publish, track results, and improve performance
Manage the editorial calendar. Plan and prioritize website pages, blogs, guides, ebooks, and FAQs based on business goals
Set the quality standard for content and make sure everything published follows Hevo's messaging and tone
Work with writers, subject matter experts, freelancers, and agencies to get content created, edited, and published
Repurpose content across blogs, AI search engines, sales materials, and social media to extract more value from every piece
Optimize content to rank on Google and appear in AI search results. Own inbound and AEO, including schema, website structure, and making content accessible to search engines and AI crawlers
Build and maintain a backlink and digital PR strategy to strengthen domain authority
Run experiments on content performance, headlines, CTAs, and formats, and iterate based on conversion data rather than traffic alone
Set up and maintain dashboards (Looker Studio, GA4, GSC) that give a single view of content performance across the full funnel
 
2. Trial Lifecycle and Activation
Define what trial success looks like: set activation milestones, instrument the funnel, and report on conversion performance weekly
Map the trial journey from signup through first pipeline to the aha moment and conversion, and identify where intent drops
Design and run lifecycle communications: onboarding email sequences, in-app nudges, and re-engagement flows tied to behavioral triggers
Act as the internal voice of the trial user in product, GTM, and leadership conversations
3. Conversion Rate Optimization
Synthesize behavioral data (session recordings, funnel drop-off, in-app events) into structured conversion hypotheses with clear success metrics
Design and execute CRO across onboarding flows, high-intent landing pages, and trial touchpoints, with documented methodology and learnings
Partner with Design on landing page variants for use-case pages, competitor comparison pages, and ICP-segment pages. You define the hypothesis and copy, Design executes
Maintain a rigorous experiment log: hypothesis, variant rationale, statistical methodology, results, and learnings
4. Product and GTM Partnership
Surface structured, prioritized insights from organic visitors and trial users into the roadmap process weekly
Build technically credible collateral: setup walkthroughs, migration guides, and competitive comparison assets written for data practitioners, not buyers
Create and maintain a weekly product-to-GTM feedback brief synthesizing signals from content performance, trials, support tickets, and deal reviews
Support competitive displacement motions with content and push customers toward a switch decision

What You Need to Bring
Non-Negotiable
5–8 years across Inbound, or PLG at a B2B SaaS company, preferably selling to technical buyers, with direct ownership of organic performance or a self-serve conversion program and measurable outcomes
Strong writing and editing skills. Comfortable across thought leadership, technical content, and competitor comparison pages
Hands-on data background, or close enough experience alongside a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Scientist to write for that audience without translation
Working understanding of PLG mechanics: activation frameworks, aha-moment design, in-product lifecycle marketing, and trial funnel instrumentation
Behavioral analytics skills: Amplitude, Mixpanel, or PostHog for funnel and activation tracking, plus Hotjar or FullStory for session analysis
Experimentation discipline across both content and product surfaces: A/B tests run with proper statistical methodology, not just a headline swap
Experience building dashboards or reports that connect content, SEO, and lifecycle metrics to pipeline and business outcomes

Strong Advantage
Experience improving visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, and Gemini
Familiarity with ELT, data pipelines, or other technical products in a fast-growing startup environment
Familiarity with PLG tools: in-app messaging (Appcues, Pendo, or equivalent), lifecycle email (Customer.io, Braze), and interactive demos (Arcade, Navattic, Storylane)
Experience with competitive displacement content at the trial stage
Basic HTML/CSS comfort to push copy or CTA edits without filing a ticket
 
What Good Looks Like at 6 Months

Milestone
What It Looks Like
30 Days
Organic content audit and trial funnel audit both complete. Activation milestones defined. Editorial calendar live. First lifecycle experiment shipped.
90 Days
Organic traffic and AI visibility trending up against baseline. 5+ CRO or lifecycle experiments shipped with documented outcomes. Onboarding email sequence live and instrumented.
180 Days
Measurable improvement in organic pipeline contribution and trial-to-paid conversion. Competitive trial-stage and comparison content covering top displacement scenarios. Lifecycle and content experimentation embedded in sprint cycles.
Tools You Will Work With

Category
Tools
SEO / AEO
Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, AI visibility tracking tools
Web Analytics
GA4, Looker Studio
Product Analytics
Amplitude / Mixpanel / PostHog
Session Analysis
Hotjar / FullStory / Microsoft Clarity
Experimentation
VWO / Optimizely / Google Optimize
Lifecycle Marketing
Customer.io / Braze / equivalent
In-Product Messaging
Appcues / Pendo / equivalent
Demo & Interactives
Arcade / Navattic / Storylane 
This Role Is Not for You If
You have only done content marketing or demand gen and have never owned a self-serve conversion funnel with measurable outcomes
You need a separate analyst to tell you where the funnel is breaking before you can act
You have never written for a technical audience and are relying on learning it on the job
You treat content and lifecycle marketing as calendars to fill rather than systems that respond to data

title: Product Manager
content:
Product Manager - Hevo 

The Hard Thing About Data 
Most companies that claim to have a "data platform" have a dashboard with some charts and a dream. Hevo has something different. Something that took eight years to build and can't be bought. Over 2,000 companies send us their most sensitive data every single day. 100 billion events a month. Raw. Unfiltered. Before transformation, before aggregation, at the exact moment truth is created. That's not a product feature. That's trust, earned one customer at a time, over eight years, by not screwing up. 
That position is now the foundation for something much bigger. We're building an Intelligence Layer on top of it, a system that reads across every data source a company runs, connects the signals that matter, and tells people what to do before they have to go looking for answers. We call it the Context Graph. It's real enough to show results. Early enough that the person who joins now defines what it becomes. 
This is the moment. Not the moment after it's obvious. Now. 
What You're Walking Into 
You'll own a product pod. SaaS integrations, database connectors, or the Intelligence Layer, depending on where the biggest need is when you join. You own the backlog. More importantly, you own the why behind everything that gets built. You report directly to the CEO. In the first 3-6 months, your job is to make the foundation bulletproof, find the gaps in the platform, close them, and make the product sharper than it's ever been. After that, you move into the Intelligence Layer and help define what Hevo becomes in its next chapter. 
What This Job Actually Is 
Let's be honest about what great PMs do, and what mediocre ones do instead. Mediocre PMs write specs and hand them off. They synthesize feedback from CSMs and call it customer insight. They sit in architecture meetings and nod. They measure their own output in documents shipped, not outcomes delivered. That's not this job. This job is three things, done well, simultneously. 
First: technical ownership. You will be in the room when architecture decisions get made. Not watching. Contributing. Pushing back. Asking the questions that change the direction of the decision. You need to understand how data pipelines work at a systems level, CDC, connectors, streaming, schema management, failure modes. If you can't hold your own in that room, engineering will stop inviting you to it. And they'll be right to. 

Second: direct customer engagement. You talk to customers yourself. No intermediary. No secondhand summary. You hear the problem in the customer's own words, you sit with the complexity of it, and you own the translation into product decisions. If you're relying on a CSM to tell you what customers need, you will always be one step behind. 

Third: making complexity simple. Hevo's product is deeply technical. The people who sell it and support it are not always. A big part of your job is taking complex system behavior and making it crisp and understandable, for Support, for CS, for Solutions Engineering, so they can represent the product confidently to customers. If internal teams are confused, customers will be  too. 
Who We're Looking For 
6-8 years of product experience. Meaningful time on platform or infrastructure products at B2B companies. Not optional. 
 
Strong technical depth. CS degree or equivalent engineering background. You should be able to hold a real conversation about system design, data architecture, API design, and engineering tradeoffs, not a surface level one. 
 
Proven ability to engage directly with customers. Not customer research. Not user interviews handed to you by a researcher. Direct engagement, gathering requirements, presenting product direction, handling objections in real time. 
 
Clear, structured communication. Written and verbal. You can make a complex system understandable to a non-technical audience without sacrificing accuracy. This is rarer than it sounds. 
 
High ownership. You don't wait for conditions to be perfect. You move. You iterate. You follow through. When you say you'll do something, it gets done. 
 
Nice to have: Engineer-turned-PM. Experience at a Series A-C company where you had to balance speed with quality. Familiarity with the data integration and pipeline landscape. 
What Good Looks Like in Year One
After 12 months, a great hire will have: 
Full, unambiguous ownership of their pod's backlog, with a defensible point of view on priorities that's grounded in customer reality and business impact. 
Identified and closed the most critical gaps in their product area, with improvements that  customers and internal teams can actually feel. 
Built enough technical depth to shape architecture decisions, not observe them. 
Become the person in the company most connected to what customers actually need from their product area.
Made internal teams measurably better at representing the product. 
Started actively shaping the Intelligence Layer, contributing product thinking and customer  insight as Hevo moves into its next chapter. 
The Moment 
Hevo spent eight years building both a product and a business simultaneously, and the foundation is real. 
 
The Intelligence Layer is early. The window to define what it becomes is open right now. Most people will look at this moment in five years and wish they'd been here for it. 
If you're one of the people who wants to be here for it, let's talk.

title: Senior Customer Experience Engineer
content:
About Hevo
Hevo Data is a no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.
Over 2,000 data teams in 45+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Arhaus, and Santander. We’re top-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.
Role Summary
The Senior Customer Experience Engineer takes ownership of the CX team's most complex, ambiguous, and high-impact customer issues, leading technical investigations through to resolution while keeping customers clearly informed throughout.
With deep specialization in JDBC-based sources and integrations, the role acts as the technical bridge between customers, CX, Product, and Engineering. Beyond resolving individual tickets, this role is expected to strengthen support processes, expand the use of AI and automation, build technical depth across the team, and mentor other CX engineers — pushing the team toward greater speed, accuracy, and consistency in service delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Own complex, ambiguous, and high-impact customer issues from investigation through resolution, with clear and proactive customer communication throughout.
Act as the technical escalation point for L1 and Associate CXEs, offering troubleshooting guidance and helping the team avoid unnecessary Engineering escalations.
Diagnose issues using SQL, logs, API responses, database behavior, and product internals — going beyond surface-level troubleshooting.
Partner with Engineering and Product on complex issues by providing strong technical context, reproduction steps, impact assessment, and investigation findings.
Spot recurring issues and work with Engineering/Product to drive permanent fixes, rather than repeatedly patching the same symptoms.
Participate in — and where appropriate, lead — customer-impacting incidents and high-priority escalations.
Drive improvements to support processes, tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows that cut resolution time, reduce repeat issues, and lower manual effort.
Build and own technical depth in areas such as JDBC integrations, databases, APIs, and data pipelines, acting as the team's internal subject-matter expert.
Mentor Associate CXEs and teammates through case reviews, technical coaching, and knowledge sharing, and show broader team citizenship — covering escalations, contributing to shared SOPs/KBs, and flagging process gaps beyond your own scope.
Own and continuously improve technical documentation, SOPs, KBs, and enablement material for the wider team.
What Success Looks Like
Consistent ownership and resolution of complex, high-impact technical issues, with strong customer communication throughout.
Low rate of avoidable escalations, and high-quality escalations when Engineering involvement is genuinely required.
Fewer recurring issues and repeat contacts, with reduced dependency on Engineering over time.
Visible improvements delivered through process, tooling, AI, and automation initiatives.
Demonstrated technical enablement and mentoring impact on Associate CXEs and teammates.
Effective, low-friction collaboration with Engineering and Product on customer-impacting issues.
Strong ownership of incidents, escalations, and designated technical knowledge areas.
Required Skills & Experience
Strong grasp of cloud technologies, databases, and integrations, with hands-on experience troubleshooting applications end-to-end.
Strong SQL skills and hands-on debugging experience across databases, applications, and integrations.
Solid knowledge of JDBC-based integrations and the connectivity concepts behind them.
Working knowledge of data warehousing, ETL, REST APIs, webhooks, and distributed systems fundamentals.
Familiarity with Java or another object-oriented programming language.
Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, research, and problem-solving abilities.
Solid track record in technical product support, including email-based support operations.
Experience producing technical documentation and enabling other technical team members.
Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly.
Ability to independently prioritize and drive complex issues across multiple teams.
Preferred Qualifications
3–6 years of experience in technical product support, application support, database/integration support, or a similar technical role.
1+ years of hands-on experience troubleshooting JDBC sources or integrations.
DBA experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or similar databases.
Experience supporting B2B SaaS, integration, or data infrastructure products.
Experience handling customer-impacting incidents and complex technical escalations.
Experience with ETL or data integration platforms.

title: Senior Product Designer
content:
About Hevo
 
Hevo moves data for more than 2,000 companies, including IcelandAir, Shopify, Postman, ThoughtSpot. What looks simple on the surface sits on top of some of the most complex machinery in software: pipelines pulling from 150+ sources, running every hour of every day, failing in a hundred different ways and recovering before anyone notices.
 
Your job is to make all of that feel obvious.
 
This is one of the harder product design jobs going in India right now, and we want you to know that upfront. You are not designing a three-screen consumer app or a marketing site. You are designing for data engineers and analysts. They are technical, they are in a hurry, and they have no patience for design that gets in their way. If a workflow confuses them, they do not "figure it out." They leave. Good design here is not decoration. It is the product.
 
One more thing before you read further: this role is AI-first, and we mean it as a requirement, not a bonus. We explain exactly what that means below. Please read it closely.

title: Senior Sales Engineer

About Hevo

title: Solution Engineer (Post-sales)
content:
About Hevo
DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc. 
We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune-based company with 2000+ customers spread across 45+ countries in e-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper-growth!
Why do we exist?
At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
Hevo Pipeline is a no-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40+ countries to be more data-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
The Role
We are growing into mid-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar - and the stakes - are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post-sale motion to match.
Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart. 
As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets. 
You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management - a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
What You Will Do
Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations - architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior-level technical engagements.
Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance - both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
Contribute to internal knowledge - documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post-sales team.
What We Are Looking For
Required
6+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role - Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post-sale or consulting function.
Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
Hands-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level - not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.
Nice to Have
Experience in a pre-sales or post-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
Prior experience in a startup or high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
What You Will Not Be Doing
This is not a support role, a ticket-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level - and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.
What We Offer
Competitive compensation and/or equity.
Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post-sale function is built.
A collaborative, high-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.

title: Solutions Engineer
content:
About the role

This role is a strong fit for data engineers with 2 to 4 years of experience who want to take their technical depth into a customer-facing role. If you have spent the last few years building pipelines, working with cloud warehouses, and solving real data problems, but you are starting to wonder what comes next, this is worth a closer look.

In this role, you will work directly with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs at companies evaluating Hevo across the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and ANZ. You will help them design the right data architecture, walk them through trade-offs, and earn the technical trust that turns an evaluation into a partnership. You will do this independently, often as the sole technical person on the call. There is no senior SE in the background. You need to walk into a Zoom with a VP of Data Engineering at a US fintech or a Head of Analytics at a European e-commerce company, earn their technical respect in the first five minutes, and hold it for the rest of the engagement.

The technical depth you have built does not go away. It gets applied to a much wider set of problems, a much larger audience, and a global stage.

Hevo runs real-time data pipelines from 150+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies, including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goals.


Why this role is worth considering

A. You move from building pipelines to shaping data strategy

In your current role, you build what is specified. In this role, you sit with senior data leaders and help them decide what to build across the modern data stack. Your existing experience in CDC, warehouse design, and pipeline reliability becomes the foundation for higher-leverage work.

B. You get global exposure that is hard to find elsewhere

You will be in regular technical conversations with Heads of Data and CTOs at fast-growing companies across North America, Europe, and beyond. You will run discovery, defend architecture choices, and present in rooms where decisions get made. This is rare exposure for someone at the 2 to 4 year mark, and almost unheard of from Bangalore.

C. Your technical depth stays central

This is not a pivot away from engineering. Everything you know about Postgres, CDC, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, and pipeline reliability gets used every day. The difference is that your technical opinion shapes the customer’s architecture instead of staying inside a Jira ticket.

D. The career path is real

Strong performers in this role grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the function, or move into product, customer success leadership, or founding-engineer roles at their next company. The optionality this role builds is significant.

What you will do

Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations, primarily with customers in North America and Europe, and you will own them end to end.
Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e.g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4, Snowflake, dbt).
Run live product demos tailored to the customer’s stack. These are not scripted walkthroughs. You will need to read the room, adapt on the fly, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.
Own the technical evaluation from first conversation to closed deal by addressing deep technical questions and earning trust with engineering teams.
Build proofs-of-concept by configuring real pipelines from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.
Develop deep expertise in the data integration landscape, including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) as well as other data pipeline and integration platforms, and articulate Hevo’s technical advantages in a way that lands with both technical and non-technical buyers.
Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins, and with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs after a deal closes.
Share customer feedback and patterns with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.

What we are looking for

Must-haves

2 to 4 years of hands-on experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or data warehouse engineer.
Experience building and operating real data pipelines in production, including handling source schema changes, failures, and reliability issues.
Strong fundamentals in SQL and at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).
Experience with at least one orchestration or transformation tool (Airflow, dbt, or similar).
Exceptional communication and presentation skills. This is non-negotiable. You will be the face of Hevo’s technical capability to a global customer base. That means:
Your spoken English is clear, confident, and easy to follow for an international audience. You are comfortable presenting to groups of 5 to 15 people, including senior technical leaders, over video calls. You can structure a technical narrative, not just answer questions but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion. You can hold your own when a customer pushes back or challenges your recommendation. You have presented or demo’d something technical to an audience before, in any context: internal reviews, client calls, meetups, or conferences.
Genuine interest in customer-facing work, even if you have not done it formally before.

Good to have

Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms, whether cloud-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) or third-party pipeline and integration tools.
Exposure to multiple source system types such as CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.
Public technical writing, conference talks, or open-source contributions.
Prior experience in customer conversations, even informally. For example, presenting to internal stakeholders, analytics teams, or working with international teams across time zones.

content:

Hevo is a simple, intuitive, and powerful No-code Data Pipeline platform that enables companies to consolidate data from multiple software for faster analytics.
 
Hevo powers data analytics for 2000+ data-driven companies across multiple industry verticals including Deliverr, Zepto, DoorDash, PhysicsWallah, Betway etc. By automating complex data integration tasks, Hevo allows data teams to focus on deriving groundbreaking insights and driving their businesses forward.
 
Hevo’s mission is simple but bold: Build technology from India, for the world that is simple to adopt and easy to access so that everyone can unlock the potential of data.

title: Strategy & Ops (Founder's Office)
content:
Read this part first
Experience: 2 to 8 years
Location: HSR Layout, BLR
Most Strategy and Operations roles quietly turn into reporting jobs. You pull the numbers, format the decks, and remind people about deadlines. This is not that role.
This is the role for someone who wants to learn, at close range, how a fast growing company actually plans, prioritizes, and executes. You will work directly with the CEO and the leadership team on the problems that cut across functions, the ones no single team can solve alone. Your job is to turn ambiguity into a plan, and a plan into results.
For the right person, this also happens to be one of the best leadership educations available anywhere. People who do this job well at Hevo build the instincts of a real operator, and many go on to run things. But the simplest reason to take it is this: you get to work on what matters most, alongside the people who decide it.
What you will own:
1. The operational rhythm of the whole company. You will work with the CEO to keep the entire machine moving across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, HR, Solutions, and Support. You will run the OKR process with the leadership team, drive quarterly planning and goal setting, and track delivery so nothing important slips. You will be the person who can tell, on any given day, how healthy the organization really is and where attention is needed next.
2. The strategic projects that move the needle. You will partner with the CEO and other leaders to spot the initiatives that genuinely change the trajectory of the business, then own them end to end until they are big enough to stand on their own and get handed to a dedicated team. These are the bets that matter most, and you will be trusted to carry them.
3. Cross functional execution and alignment. You will be the connective tissue across functions, driving communication so the company moves as one. You will be a real thought partner to leadership on vision, priorities, and the hard tradeoffs. You will manage relationships with stakeholders inside and outside the company, and when needed, represent leadership in reviews.

title: Tech Lead Manager - Autonomous Connectors
content:
What we are building
We are building an AI system that creates data connectors by itself and keeps them working by itself.
No engineer should need to manually build every connector. No engineer should need to come back six months later because the source API changed.
Work that traditionally takes weeks or months should take hours. But building a connector is not the hardest part.
The real question is: Would you trust this system to run by itself, with nobody watching, for months?
That is the job.

title: Technical Account Manager
content:
About Hevo
Hevo Data is a no-code data pipeline platform used by 2,000+ companies across 45+ countries, including DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus and Santander. We help teams move data from 150+ sources (databases, SaaS apps, cloud storage, streaming services) into their warehouse, without needing to build or maintain pipelines. We’re backed by Sequoia Capital and based in San Francisco, Bangalore and Pune.
The Role
As a Technical Account Manager, you own the technical side of the customer relationship once a customer is live on Hevo. You work directly with their data engineers, analysts and architects, and you’re their bridge to Hevo’s Support, Product and Engineering teams. This is a technical, execution-led role: you earn customer trust by solving problems, following through and spotting risk early. It is not a ticket-handling role.
What You’ll Do
Own a book of mid-market and enterprise accounts through onboarding, adoption, renewal and expansion
Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews and solution design as customers add new sources, use cases or migrations
Troubleshoot complex pipeline issues (replication lag, schema changes, connector failures) and drive them to root cause
Make the customer’s case internally to Support, Product and Engineering, and keep both sides aligned on what’s possible
Spot churn signals early (low adoption, stalled pipelines, unresolved issues) and act before they become escalations
Identify expansion opportunities and hand them to Account Managers with clear context
Document patterns and reference architectures to raise the technical bar across the team
What We’re Looking For
5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role: TAM, Solutions Engineer/Architect, Customer Engineer or technical consulting, ideally at a SaaS or data infrastructure company
Working knowledge of ETL/ELT, CDC, databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks)
Hands-on with SQL and at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP or Azure); comfortable with REST APIs and basic networking (SSH tunnels, IP allowlisting, VPCs)
Python or scripting to debug, inspect data or automate
Track record of owning customer outcomes, not just activities
Clear communication with both engineers and senior stakeholders, and confidence to push back when a customer’s approach is wrong
Nice to Have
Experience with dbt, Kafka, Airflow or other modern data stack tools
Exposure to data governance or compliance requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA)
Startup or high-growth B2B SaaS experience
What We Offer
Competitive compensation and equity
Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post-sales function is built
A high-trust team where technical depth is valued

title: Technical Writer
content:
About Hevo
At Hevo Data, we’re building the future of data infrastructure for AI. Over 2,000 companies across 40+ countries trust Hevo to power their analytics. As a deep tech company, our engineering team solves some of the hardest problems in data integration, scale, and reliability.
We’re looking for a Technical Writer who goes beyond polishing prose. We want someone who tests the product hands-on, reads connector configs and API references, and verifies every documented behavior before it ships. You’ll use AI tools like Claude to work faster, and you’ll have the judgment to catch what AI gets wrong.
👉 If you can speak the language of engineers and turn complex data integration behavior into docs people trust, let’s talk.
What you’ll do
Own documentation for new features and Sources end-to-end, from reading connector configuration and specs through testing, review, and PR merge, with minimal supervision.
Test features in the product: create test accounts and data, run Pipelines, and verify the loaded data in the Destination (for example, with SQL), so every documented behavior is confirmed.
Read connector configuration (YAML/JSON), API references, and code, with AI help, to understand authentication, sync modes, delete handling, and rate limits.
Use Claude and Claude skills to draft, restructure, and QA large docs. Critically review the output for invented behavior, wrong links, and unsupported claims.
Review automation-generated drafts and their open flags, and confirm each point with Product or Engineering before publishing.
Automate repetitive content such as object tables, ERDs, link checks, and consistent screenshots instead of producing them by hand.
Raise clear engineering queries and bug reports, with steps to reproduce and expected versus actual results, and track them to closure in Jira and Confluence.
Work in Git: branch, raise PRs, resolve conflicts, run local builds, and respond to review comments.
Help evolve our documentation standards, templates, and style guides. When AI output repeatedly needs the same fixes, improve the prompts and skills behind it.
Review associate writers’ work and share effective research methods and prompts.
What you bring
3–5 years of technical writing experience, preferably for SaaS, API, or data products.
Strong written English and the ability to explain complex technical behavior simply and accurately.
Working knowledge of APIs and data integration concepts: OAuth and API key authentication, incremental and full loads, schemas, and primary keys.
Hands-on docs-as-code experience: Markdown, YAML, Git, and a static site generator (for example, Jekyll).
Daily, confident use of AI tools for research, drafting, and review, including creating and maintaining Claude skills and prompts.
The ability to read code and config files and write basic SQL queries.
The ability to set up test environments and test features end-to-end on your own.
The ability to manage several tickets in parallel, track dependencies on releases and engineering answers, and communicate status proactively.
Nice to have
Experience documenting ETL/ELT, data integration, or developer products.
Basic scripting (Python or shell) to automate documentation tasks.
Experience with ERD tools (for example, dbdocs) and browser automation for screenshots (for example, Playwright).
Why Hevo
Work on docs for a data platform used by 2,000+ companies worldwide.
Own your work from spec to merged PR, with real trust and autonomy.
Work in an AI-forward team that expects you to use, question, and improve the tools.
Collaborate directly with engineers solving hard problems in data integration, scale, and reliability.

title: AM/ Manager - Risk & Decision Science
content:
About the Team

Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here’s your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit and built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys, Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of 10-100-1000 journey and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
As a Financial Services team, we always look at the bottom line. And the bottom line is - in this team, you should expect to have fun as you learn and grow.
 
About the Role
 
Lending is going to be our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale. Herein also lies potentially our biggest challenge for Meesho users: How do we assess risk of borrowers without any credit history? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
The Person will be responsible for driving the Policy, DS and analytics behind all these questions, from creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and owning policy decisions.
In the early phases, your role will focus on refining initially implemented policy by Analyzing and Designing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, alternate data. Creating Scorecards and models for approval. 
Designing experiments to test cohort behavior and experimental policies.
Automate reporting and tracking of the portfolio on multiple levels , Ops performance measures, key performance indicators and associated drivers.

title: AM/M - Risk Analytics - User Lending
content:
About the Team
Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here's your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit, built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys. Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of a 10-100-1000 journey, and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
About the Role
Meesho FS runs two lines of business: SME Lending, which offers Business Loans, and User Lending, which offers BNPL and Personal Loans (PL). 
User Lending is now our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey. We have 274Mn ATU, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale - our being a captive audience means both Growth and Risk are an outcome of underwriting, which is owned by the Risk team.
Herein also lies one of our biggest challenges: how do we assess the risk of borrowers without any credit history or income data? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
This person will be responsible for driving the analytics behind these questions for User Lending - creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and recommending policy decisions, across a well-established BNPL portfolio and a Personal Loans portfolio that is still scaling.
Your role will focus on:
Owning the risk for one or more segments of the portfolio while maintaining a healthy growth.
Analyzing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, SMS data, and other alternate data.
Creating policies, scorecards and models (Application Score, B-Score, Collection Scores) for BNPL and PL.
Designing experiments to test cohort behaviour, experimental policies, and new opportunities for growth.
Identifying pockets of risk within the portfolio that don't make sense, and identifying leading indicators / EWS.
Automating reporting and tracking of the portfolio at multiple levels - Ops performance measures, key performance indicators, and their drivers.
Refining credit policies based on data and creating new policies for unexplored segments, including building day-1 policies for Personal Loans as the product scales.
Configuring and testing rules in the real-time Business Rule Engine (BRE), and working with the Bureau Feature Store to define new underwriting features.

title: Data Scientist III (Team- Valmo)
content:
About us
Meesho - Every story here begins with a spark of ambition and a touch of entrepreneurial magic. We're not just a platform — we're your partner in transforming dreams into reality.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone - Meesho started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable small businesses to succeed online. We provide sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping costs, growing their business by tapping the company's massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics at cost through third-party logistics providers and our in-house logistics arm Valmo, in an 'Everyday Low Cost' channel for sellers.
Affordable, relatable merchandise mirroring local markets has helped us make inroads with first-time internet users in the country. We cater to an underserved and unique customer base and cover every serviceable pincode in the country. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have enabled us to become the first Indian horizontal e-commerce company.
Know more about Meesho here: https://www.meesho.io/
About Valmo and the Data Science Team
Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models.
 About the Role
As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile.
